result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly. One clear defect was found: a '€NaN delivery' price on the Smash Bros Burgers card, indicating a failed number computation. No other visual breakage was identified; partially visible carousel items and the bottom card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, exposing a JavaScript NaN value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee data before rendering; fall back to a sensible display such as 'Free delivery' or 'Delivery fee unavailable' when the value is missing or non-numeric, and fix the upstream data/parsing that produces NaN.
